title: Budget-Aware Tool Use Enables Effective Agent Scaling
topic: 预算感知与测试时扩展
code_status: 公开Apache-2.0作者仓库，固定37d23f66c512734db476313cf436a506edbec9e0；只读README，不克隆/运行/下载或解密benchmark。Google官网旧摘要名CATS，固定v2和公开代码名BATS。
summary: 持续向Agent展示每工具已用/剩余预算；用显式自验证决定CONTINUE/PIVOT/SUCCESS，换路不重置预算，任一工具耗尽即终止，并按token及工具实际消耗统一计费。
fidelity_note: 仅CPU预算/费用/显式外部verdict状态核，不产生计划、语义验证、摘要或答案。无gold/reference字段；外部selector必须选择已接受集合，完整搜索Agent及Evolve未接入。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.bats import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.source_location: §5,Appendix A.1–2 and B; official repository README
cost_assessment.model_scale: Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro and Claude-Sonnet-4; up to64K–65,536generated tokens with self-verification and final LLM judge
cost_assessment.data_scale: BrowseComp1,266questions(author code also200subset), BrowseComp-ZH289, HLE-Search200; multiple tool-budget curves and supplementary tasks
cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Paid multi-model search/browse and repeated verification matrix; paper tool rate USD0.001/call is a historical post-hoc average, not current pricing. No local full-run hours measured.
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；不调用API、不下载/解密题目、不接触gold，仅执行CPU控制与费用核。
